name: Facet
text: I'll open a new branch `feature/whole-interface-visibility` and create a minimal prototype in `src/vis/dashboard-liveliness.html`—a 3-panel layout with animated SVG counters (target: 5 key metrics, 30fps), a live data feed from `data/realtime.json` (simulated with 100ms updates), and a color scheme from `styles/palette.css` (6 hues max). I'll wire it to a local server (`python -m http.server 8000`) and log FPS to console to validate "liveliness" before expanding.

name: Pane
text: Pane: "You’re committing to a 30fps SVG counter prototype before validating the *actual* performance ceiling of the real-time feed—what’s your fallback if the browser chokes on 100ms updates with 50+ concurrent users? And why assume a 3-panel layout is the *whole* interface’s sweet spot without testing user task flows first?"
